# COLD-CANOPY-M1 — executable thermodynamic integration

## Projection-cache experiment — adopted 2026-09-30, active

Owner adopted `/tmp/openwepp_cold_canopy_m1_projection_cache_authorization.md`.
Deliver only once-per-damping-search invariant projection extraction in private
accepted cut09; main Rust/native integration and all old physical slots remain stopped.
Performance acceptance leads: stable cold 750 us, mixed 1.5 ms, transition 2.5 ms
CPU per completed OFE-day remain unchanged; no completed-day or whole-run evidence
exists. Approximately 100x proposal improvement is the recorded scale concern.
Comparable baseline/treatment CPU and wall costs are pending, not inferred from
historical instrumented G4 5.463608 ms wall.

[Start receipt](artifacts/projection-cache-start.json): verified archive SHA256
`8c8bb484098c98abb19147fe158bfad3522a5efd8115bb6f31249fcc40a292ad`, all 764
reference entries match accepted tree `04465bc08aa8d991b856a6caf130bc8543c5a2bb6608939bdf6ed9821bb38e3b`.
Reference remains untouched at `/home/roger/openwepp-experiments/cold-canopy-m1-20260920`.
Mutable arms start under `/home/roger/openwepp-experiments/cold-canopy-m1-projection-cache-20260930/`.
Carry verified from bvls05-final-ledger: 427743.393795 seconds; ceiling
434943.393795. Conservative first-reading anchor 03:22 UTC, work cutoff 04:52,
hard deadline 05:22 on 2026-09-30; 1800 seconds reserved, no wait deductions,
old-balance additions or re-anchoring. Commands capped at 180 seconds.

Implementation intent: preserve binary64 traversal, grouped arithmetic, guards,
lambda coefficients, explicit V reconstruction, norms, 48 bisections and all
refinement callers. Only local invariant cache plus identical optional-observation
and benchmark plumbing in both detached arms is authorized. Read canonical LSE
numerical clauses before edits; any required clarification is limited to invariant
evaluation and truthful actual-versus-conservative work accounting. No new
acceptance policy. One implementer and distinct correctness/QA reviewers; no nested
agents. Freeze separate snapshots before result-bearing commands; mutation stops work.

Recorded deployment screens retained: at most eight charged maps/support,
stable median <=2 and p95 <=4; T10/T1 <=12 and T19/T10 <=2.2;
warm CPU/wall regression <=5% from at least six balanced pairs; whole-process
memory 128 MiB +16 MiB/OFE. Include induced LSE/gas/hydraulic/receiver costs.
No additional adopted whole-run wall ceiling was recovered from this package's
record; the 100-year/five-OFE concern does not supply a completed-run denominator.
None of those screens is measured by this proposal-only experiment.

Fixed physical cohort: unchanged G4 exact endpoint
`m1_coupled_tests::m1_trust_region_retained_phase_capacity_tie_uses_actual_model`:
one diagnostic invocation per arm, then 16 fresh-proposal warmups per arm,
then six pairs of 32 fresh proposals, orders B/T,T/B,B/T,T/B,B/T,T/B.
Same authenticated input/seed, release configuration and optional capture disabled
in timed regions; algorithmic guards/counters remain. Initialization/proposal/combined
wall and supported high-resolution CPU clocks measured separately; consume complete
outputs outside timing. No extra physical case or opportunistic repeat. At most one
affected-arm replay only after independent defect verification.

Readiness review (Static): correctness reviewer `/root/correctness` independently
confirmed private `#[cfg(test)]` reachability at detached `lib.rs:131–162` and
empty staging features/defaults. QA `/root/qa` confirmed the same. Classify this
exact intended extraction as **Bounded Component**, not a semantic alteration of
a production/shared primitive. Any reachability, unsafe, dependency, compiler,
feature or acceptance-policy drift escalates; prior Critical M1 HOLDs remain.
Canonical LSE numerical-methods §§Deterministic bounded subproblem and refinement
already authorize the formula/ordered arithmetic; no authority amendment is needed.
The first lambda evaluation must retain per-column projection/coefficient guard
interleaving before any reuse. Refinement retains its original distinct-RHS path.
The owner's 1,380,960 estimate is specifically A*V MAC terms in four48 bisections
(`48*21*(19²+18²+19²+18²)`), excluding U*y and other operations, not measured time.

Prospective bounded inherited-lint policy: compare same command/toolchain baseline
and treatment source-bearing diagnostics; preserve both strict failures and reject
new relevant diagnostics unless independently verified equivalent relocation.
No lint waiver for a Critical change. Physical timing uses safe Rust pipe boundaries
and Python supported Linux per-child process CPU clock `((~pid)<<3)|2` (fail closed
if unavailable), plus monotonic wall; nominal resolutions and raw timestamps retained.
Fixture parsing/process startup/output comparison excluded. Boundary pipe overhead
is retained identically and explicitly reported, never subtracted without evidence.

Internal reassessment after unsuccessful local correction cycles: continue only
within the same allowance. Failures are bounded test/build plumbing defects (false
subnormal expectation, module-qualified prepared-controller helper, and overbroad
text extraction of the test oracle). The corrected reference helper now matches the
entire accepted `lambda_step` after function rename/whitespace normalization, and
module-qualified calls fix the compiler finding. Next action is frozen focused
verification, then missing independent changed-input/refinement controls; no new
scientific method, allowance or physical invocation is inferred.

Current execution evidence: `projection-cache-treatment-check01.json` PASS
on frozen02 with source/pins unchanged. Focused `projection-cache-treatment-controls01.json`
FAIL is preserved: guard-order test wrongly expected the first cached projection
to remain +0 after a coefficient overflow; independent correctness identified its
actual nonzero subnormal before the assertion ran. No numerical-body defect found
by static review. Fix and immutable-full-original differential controls are pending.
Early tooling attempts returned cargo-not-found and missing known external archive
supports; no physical work occurred. The first cargo-not-found attempts used DEV
rather than frozen copies (process could not start; no source mutation). Subsequent
checks use immutable cuts. Existing support links were restored only in new copies.

QA rejected premature benchmark readiness for discarded INIT inputs, mislabeled
projection counts and remaining diagnostic serialization. Fixes must split the same
canonical controller initialization/proposal and preserve algorithmic counters;
new optional reconstruction capture is disabled during timing and reported only
in diagnostic/analytic evidence. The Python driver/analysis passed nonphysical mocks
(including `python -O` guard verification); mocks do not establish performance.
No G4 diagnostic or measurement batch has run yet.

Validation intent: analytic independent expectations and immutable old-body bit
comparison for zero/positive lambda, radius outcomes, changed RHS/factors, nonfinite/
overflow, remaining rank, signed zeros, active faces, refinement and once-per-search
count; preserve complete G4 assertions and compare outcomes. Select exact analytic
filters after inventory (no historical physical replay), formatting, owning-crate
lint/default exposure checks, applicable A0/A1/A3 and contract checks. Review risk
against testing strategy before result-bearing execution; Critical obligations are
not waived by diagnostic isolation. Existing full-M1 HOLDs remain unmet.

Terminal readiness before physical execution (04:12 UTC): immutable frozen13
baseline release 115/115 and treatment release 120/120 numerical controls pass;
both formatting and default library checks pass, all source/pins unchanged.
Same-toolchain strict Clippy fails with the original 299 diagnostics in each arm;
source-aware multiset comparison has zero additions/removals. Correctness and QA
independently clear terminal13 and this exact cohort, conditional on G4 equivalence.
Treatment controls include independent scalar analytic values and the full accepted
helper oracle. A0 canonical formula/guard authority is unchanged; A1 touched hard
invariants are covered by selected Stage1/Stage2 controls and exact G4. No constitutive
formula, external A3 suite posture, conservation/publication/serialization, dependency,
unsafe, default feature or production path changes; no new external A3/anti-evasion,
cargo-deny, reverse-dependent, doctest or campaign requirement is triggered.
Prior Critical/full-M1 HOLDs remain. Both release binaries are preserved under
`binaries13` with actual identities in [build identities](artifacts/projection-cache-build-identities.json).
Rust 1.95.0 (59807616e), LLVM21.1.8, Cargo1.95.0; unchanged release thin LTO,
codegen-units1/default opt3 and the same three private staging features.
The fixed protocol above now proceeds once: direct-binary original G4 diagnostic
with optional projection counting, followed only if matching by the 14 prescribed
minimally observed batches. Static expected reconstruction counts are 336 versus4;
these are hypotheses until diagnostic output verifies them. Input fixture SHA256
`4b324b0a9c136f2203e8073ca260db5be9e7dd07722a37aec60f2cd528be2d54`.

Corrected replay declaration (04:17 UTC): frozen13 diagnostics both passed all
original assertions; complete outcomes, face/controller/decision capture and G4
work are identical, with actual projection reconstructions336 versus4. The first
cohort then failed baseline warmup after16 initializations and the first proposal:
the capture-disabled encoder incorrectly required optional `phase_events.last()`.
No completed warmup outcome, treatment execution or measured pair exists. Both
reviewers independently verified this post-proposal output-seam defect and the
single affected-baseline replay eligibility; this is not a numerical negative or
noise retry. Preserve frozen13, both diagnostic receipts and failed cohort intact.
Frozen14 makes the identical minimum shared fix: retain the last successful phase
and direction as a fixed-size consumed output on both successful select-phase
branches; optional event capture remains disabled. No numeric/cache body changed.
Correctness inspected the exact patch and confirms the same last-event semantics;
no tautological synthetic test or extra physical diagnostic is added. Revalidate
format/build/default exposure and lint, then execute the same fixed schedule once:
corrected baseline warmup consumes the sole affected-arm replay, treatment warmup
and all pairs are their first executions. No further replay remains thereafter.
